title: Swap For Longest Repeated Character Substring
goal: Find the longest repeated-character substring obtainable with at most one swap.
strategy: For each target letter, maintain a window containing at most one different letter. A swap can repair that one position only if enough target copies exist globally, so cap the candidate by the target total count.
